$comment: A Windows Terminal fragment extension: dropping this file in
adds the profile below to every Windows Terminal on the machine, without
touching the user's own settings.json — which is theirs, and which an
__LAUNCHER__ and __ICON__ are replaced with real paths at install time;
the profile GUID is fixed so a reinstall updates this profile rather than
commandline is a command line, not a path: the escaped quotes around
__LAUNCHER__ are what keep it working when the installation path holds a
space. The default path contains the account name, so an account called
'Zhang San' breaks an unquoted profile on the very first launch. icon is
a plain path and must NOT be quoted.
